$comment: Descriptive only. No third-party schema engine runs. Runtime additionally enforces strict UTF8, no BOM/duplicate or unknown keys/lone surrogates; nonnegative safe integer tokens (no exponent/fraction/negative/-0), depth <=16, <=65536 raw bytes inclusive. Byte APIs accept only intrinsically copied Uint8Array/Buffer; reject Proxies without traps, SharedArrayBuffer and detached views. Encoder accepts only own enumerable data-property plain/null records and ordinary dense arrays, no getters/Proxies/classes/symbols/holes/cycles/callbacks/coercion. All data remain caller claims. Result scope is fixture-only with authenticated, policyAccepted, freshOSValidation, publicationAllowed and installationAllowed always false, including refusal results.
title: Inert inspection job v2
description: Standalone unsigned fixture descriptor, never authenticated production work, scheduling, a lease, approved route or installation authority.

uuid.description: Shape only; version and variant confer no authority.

httpsURL.description: Descriptive base shape only. Runtime validates ASCII DNS hostname with alphanumeric label edges, 1..63 bytes per label and total <=253, including single-label names; refuses IP literals and WHATWG numeric IP spellings. Only literal https:// and optional :443. Optional path starts / and contains visible ASCII only; no userinfo/query/fragment/backslash/whitespace. Every percent escape must be a hex triplet. Segments which become . or .. after case-insensitive %2e replacement are refused. Other escapes are retained literally. Exact original spelling/case/explicit port/repeated slash preserved. No network, public-address, redirect or SSRF approval.
